summary: On June 22, 2025 a woman in a mental-crisis situation threatened to jump off a bridge in Chaffee County. Sergeant Dakoda DeFurio approached as she moved under the bridge, and when she gripped the top rail and jumped he grabbed her hand and held her full body weight until other officers pulled her back to safety. She was rescued; the sergeant sustained minor injuries.
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office; Buena Vista Police Department
notes: Law-enforcement bridge rescue, rather than a wilderness SAR operation. The cited September 3 report reproduces the sheriff’s account and dates this rescue June 22, 2025; the separate August overdose response in that report is not part of this incident.
